LiveSync MD

We aim to transform conversations into clear, actionable insights, optimizing healthcare delivery through intelligent summarization. LiveSync empowers healthcare professionals to enhance patient care and improve clinical efficiency.

DRIVING THE CHANGE
Our commitment to innovation drives us to continuously embrace new technologies, solving real healthcare challenges.
How it works
Our real-time speech-to-text system leverages advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) designed to understand and process medical dialogue with high accuracy.
Seamless Integration
Our software easily integrates into existing medical systems, allowing doctors to use our solution without disrupting their workflow.
01
Local Processing
All data processing is done on-premise, ensuring that sensitive patient information never leaves the clinic’s local network, maintaining strict compliance with privacy laws.
02
User-Centric Design
Developed with input from healthcare professionals, our system is tailored to the needs of doctors and nurses, ensuring it is as intuitive and non-intrusive as possible.
03
Continuous Improvement
We regularly update our system with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning, ensuring that our technology evolves as fast as the needs of the healthcare industry.
04
